# Struc-Arch Pakistan

> Civil & structural engineering consultancy based in Gujranwala, serving all of Pakistan and Asia.

Struc-Arch is a PEC-registered structural, civil and construction-management consultancy (firm licence #Consult/2452). Principal Saad Afzal is a structural engineer - BSc Civil Engineering (UET Lahore), MSc Structural Engineering (UET Taxila), PMP, LEED Green Associate, PEC #Civil/32786.

Services: structural design & GFC drawings, BOQ & cost estimation, quantity surveying, contractor billing & IPC, building fitness certification, construction claims & EOT, construction supervision & project management.

Track record: 2,000+ buildings designed, 1,588 school structures certified, 128 km Lilla Jhelum dualization, 74.15 km Gujranwala-Hafizabad road, 15.2 km Gujranwala Expressway.

Contact: 0310 3330023, info@strucarch.com, Kacha Eminabad Road, Gujranwala 52250, Pakistan.
